breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the instruction to replace A(x) with its arithmetic mean. Instead, it directly instructs to compute the elongation using the exact integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the actual varying area A(x) = A0*(1 + k*x/L), matching the ground truth approach.
